title: Tentac — claimed by thegentlemen
description: JP · Technology · tentac.co.jp zoominfo.com/c/tentac-co-ltd/458253608 TENTAC Co., Ltd world's leading maker of robotic tool changers — automatic docking systems that let industrial robots swap end-of-arm tools (welding torch → gripper → spray gun → grinder) mid-production without stopping the line. Founded 1968 as a Kobe Steel division, spun off independent in 1985; HQ in Kobe, Japan; ~35–40 employees, ~¥1.5–2B rev
